scripts.check:structure: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['src-tauri/tauri.conf.json','src-tauri/Cargo.toml','src-tauri/src/main.rs'].forEach(p=>{if(!fs.existsSync(p)) throw new Error(p+' missing')}); console.log('desktop structure ok')"
scripts.check:release: npm run check:structure && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=require('./package.json'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src-tauri/tauri.conf.json','utf8')); if(p.name!=='scbkr-desktop'||!c.bundle.active||!c.bundle.externalBin.includes('sidecar/scbkr-api')) throw new Error('desktop release contract invalid'); if(!c.app.security.csp) throw new Error('desktop CSP is required'); console.log('desktop release contract ok')"
